nom: La Roche-Posay Anthelios Mineral Tinted Ultra Light Face Sunscreen Fluid SPF 50

avis.texte: I've tried many mineral sunscreens because my skin and eyes are hypersensitive. This particular sunscreen didn't irritate my skin or eyes, but it left my skin with an unusual tint. I have olive skin and needed a tinted sunscreen because of my red blotches. Unfortunately, it didn't blend in seamlessly like other tinted products. It was also an oddly tinted product, very dark for a "light" tint, almost muddy, which is not flattering. While it was matte, within an hour, I was an oily mess and constantly had to blot my face. Personally, I wouldn't recommend this product if you struggle with oily skin. But if sensitivity is your issue….this might work for you.

After recommendation from my dermatologist, (who uses this product, also on herself) I have been using this tinted sunscreen for several years now. I do not wear make-up. This product is easy to apply, gives me added protection from the sun & the tinting is just enough to cover. Feels light on my skin, not oily or greasy. I hightly recommend this product.
It's a great product. I've used it for years. They fixed the unpleasant smell it used to have, and now it's perfect

My dermatologist gave me a sample of this a few years ago and I have been hooked ever since. As a ginger with sensitive skin who doesn't wear a lot of makeup, this is the only sunscreen I have consistently used every day. I usually get rid of others for being too greasy, or melting in the heat, but this one was a game changer for me. Bonus pro is it evens my complexion and kinda mutes the red spots on my face with the tint.

I really like this formula and how light weight it is. I used a little sample bottle for awhile and just got the full size. The only difference is the smell….it smells bad. I didnt notice that with the sample size…it was pretty old, maybe it was a different formula? The new one definitely smells bad when putting on but I don't notice when wearing. I read another La Roche-Posay product that smelled bad too. So weird. A bit expensive, worth it when it's on sale. I also tried Ilia super serim skin timt (too dewy) and tower 28 (which I like as well when I want more coverage).
I usually love this brand, however this was a major dissappointment. Made my skin sting in the heat/sun, caked & clumped up, and made me have major break outs.

The medium version (spf 40) is darker than I expected. My skin is light or light-medium (for reference I use EL double wear matte 3N1) but the medium shade is really too dark and warm on my skin. The medium shade feels a bit less greasy than the tint version. It doesn't have a strong "suncreen" smell. One last thing. Ulta needs to update the ingredient list. The current ingredient list is WRONG.

avis.titre: I have been wearing this for years
avis.texte: I love this tinted sunscreen, it's mostly all I wear. I don't like heavy makeup. This feels like I don't have anything on my face. Makes my skin look better and I like love that it's SPF 50.

It's pricey but completely worth it. No white cast, no orange tones, and it doesn't irritate or break out my sensitive, acne prone skin. When I have acne and scarring to cover, it adds some extra coverage. This sunscreen does such a great job of protecting my skin when I'm out and about, even when it's super hot out. I usually don't repurchase sunscreens, but I've bought at least five of this one.

Could be great for the right person, but it broke me out after two uses. It also stinks, however had a nice finish and blends well with my fake tan color. I wanted it to work so bad because it's mineral. Anyways, I retuned.

I love this product. Having a sensitive face this helps out a lot. It does not aggravate my sensitive skin. The only thing I would change is maybe a bigger bottle would be nice to have. Other than that it goes on silky smooth and gives me a little color but not over board.

I love this sunscreen and it's neutral/non-orange tint is almost impossible to find in the drugstore. So when I saw that it was on sale, I was ready to repurchase, but clicked on the Ingredients tab on a whim before I checked out, and was crushed to discover that it contains PFAs (C9-15 Fluoroalcohol Phosphate). Obviously, it's on me to look at the ingredients, but I had figured since it was on the "Clean list" at Ulta (which specifically mentions mentions excluding products with PFAs), it was good to go. I am pro-science, and don't give much weight to "clean" beauty (it's not a regulated term) but PFAs are proven to be environmentally toxic and easily absorbed via the skin. I apply sunscreen every single day, and opt for this mineral sunscreen for my sensitive skin, but PFAs are NOT safe to use long-term. I can't believe I've used this for years, but will not continue using this sunscreen, and hope that LRP releases a tinted mineral sunscreen without PFAs here in the US soon. And even more salt in the would: it also contains butyloctyl salicylate, which is a chemical sunscreen, so this was never a 100% mineral sunscreen anyway.

avis.titre: Amazing Sunscreen with a beautiful Tint
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] No matter what season, the first step in my morning routine is applying this amazing tinted mineral sunscreen. It provides Broad Spectrum 50 SPF which protects my skin from the suns harmful UVA and UVB rays. This formula has a beautiful Tint which is easy to apply, dries down evenly to a soft MATTE radiant finish. My skin never looks oily nor does this product crease into my fine lines and wrinkles. Upon wearing throughout the day there is never any sticky residue or pilling.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The sunscreen feels lightweight and comfortable on my skin . It's don't feel greasy or heavy like some other sunscreen . I like that it's a mineral sunscreen because it feels gentler and is less irritating .

I was very excited to try this product as I've heard a lot of good things about it, but it just didn't work for me. It does have a lot of positives like the tint being really even and adding a nice bit of color. I'm someone who self tans so I know some people mentioned it being too dark, but it actually worked for me quite well. I also thought the oil absorbing technology did work fairly well for me. I think what some of the other reviewers were mentioning could be true if you're new to mineral sunscreens, but many of them pull shiny and this one was actually on a bit of the less shiny side. However, this product is extremely difficult to take off your skin. When I first tested it on my hand, I noticed water almost beaded off of it, which led me to believe this product's formula was almost waterproof. This in theory would be a really good quality, but when I would try to remove it at night, I struggled to do so. It felt like i could never fully get it off even with a double cleanse method. I started to get breakouts over time and atrributed this to not bejnf able to ever fully take the product off my skin causisng build up. I had to stop using. It's very difficult to find a good tinted mineral SPF with no fragrance and I wish this worked for me, but I would caution people against it if you're acne prone.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I received La Roche-Posay tinted mineral sunscreen with SPF 50, from #influenster in exchange for my honest opinion about the product. I have heard good things about this brand, but had never tried their products before. When I look at for a sunscreen I look for UVA and UVB protection, and appreciated that this was a mineral sunscreen and not a chemical sunscreen which can sometimes lead to adverse reactions on my sensitive skin. This product needs to be shaken before being used to disperse the pigments. I found that the La Roche-Posay sunscreen melted into my skin and did not leave behind a greasy residue. It is oil free. I didn't find the finish to be matte, but that didn't bother me as I like a more natural look. Also, some mineral sunscreens can leave a white cast to the skin, but this product did not. Think of this first as a sunscreen before thinking of it as a tinted moisturizer. The tint does blur imperfections, but some may prefer to use concealer or a setting powder to feel more put together. The product lasted all day and didn't cause me to break out. The reason I took one star was that the smell took some getting used to. It fades away pretty quickly but it has quite a strong chemical smell at first.
I am 80 years old, I don't wear foundation I use this everyday covers beautifully. I recommend this product highly.

The texture was also a major issue. It felt thick and greasy, and it never seemed to fully absorb into my skin. Instead, it left a shiny, oily residue that attracted dirt and made me look even worse. And don't even get me started on the white cast! Despite being tinted, it still left a noticeable white cast, especially in photos. Overall, I was really disappointed with this sunscreen. The mismatched tint, greasy texture, and white cast made it a complete miss for me. I definitely wouldn't recommend it, especially if you have oily or combination skin.

When I tell you this free product was much needed, I mean it. I suffer from hyperpigmentation, causing dark circles under my eyes. My sister was the one to go to a dermatologist about hers, and she had relayed that we must constantly wear sunscreen to avoid making it worse. This has helped tremendously.

This is good stuff! This is a great SPF with good coverage to give the appearance of smooth, dewey skin. The UV protection of this brand is always great and is one of my go-to's whenever I need to apply an SPF to my face after moisturizing. This is good to use when I'm not applying a BB cream or foundation to my skin.

This product is light weight and goes on pretty easily. This is when you want a little coverage for a quick on the go with a little effort. It is not fully waterproof so if you are not a heavy sweater, you should be good to go with using this product.

I'm obsessed with this SPF! I tend to gravitate to mineral SPFs because of the health benefits, but struggle to find options that blend easily and don't leave a white cast. Not only does this SPF blend out beautifully, but it also offers amazing coverage for a tinted product that leaves me with even, naturally glowy skin that is protected! This is my go-to product before I leave the house, whether it's an errand run, exercising, or a base to a light makeup routine for gatherings and social events. This product has become a staple in my routine!

I've tried so many makeup tints, but this one is truly a game-changer! The shade matched my skin tone perfectly, blending seamlessly for a natural, radiant look. It's lightweight, buildable, and gives just the right amount of coverage without feeling heavy or cakey. Plus, it lasts all day without fading or settling into fine lines. Whether I'm going for a fresh, no-makeup look or layering it for more coverage, it always delivers. Definitely a must-have in my routine!

As I get older, protecting my skin becomes more and more important. As a woman of color, tinted sunscreens rarely work but this KNOCKED it outta the park! Even coverage that smooths out your complexion without a gritty or ghostly white cast on your face. The packaging is easy to use and leak proof- I've taken it on multiple trips and love that the spf protects my skin while giving me a more polished look without more layers of makeup!

avis.titre: I bought this product several times already
avis.texte: Love the product, the only thing I don't love is that if it goes into my eyes it hurts.

My dermatologist recommended this to me for better protection from the damaging rays of the sun. I put on a light layer of CeraVe mineral daytime sunscreen (no tint) then a light layer of La-Roche Posey on top of it. I've never used foundation of any kind, & this is light so it doesn't feel cakey or anything.

avis.titre: Perfect amount of coverage while protecting the skin
avis.texte: This sunscreen has the perfect about of tint but also protecting the skin. Scent isn't too strong and very easy to put in purse or makeup bag. Will be repurchasing in the future.

avis.titre: Love the liquid consistency, wears like makeup
avis.texte: I have rosacea, hypersensitivity, and no reactions after 3 days of use. Product is thin like liquid makeup and looks perfect, if you top with hawaiian tropic sunscreen powder. No settling in lines and wrinkles, 51 yrs old. Only complaint is it needs to be applied immediately after normal skincare routine. When I waited to apply, my skin became very dry and uncomfortable. I would expect the product to hydrate on its own. But I was able to resolve by applying with my routine.
My cons list says it all. This is a very expensive product thag i wojldnt recommend to anyone with dry skin.

At 63, my foundation suddenly felt and LOOKED heavy. An Ulta pro said, "La Roche Posay Mineral Tint!" This smooth fluid covers just enough, adds a glow and protects skin with serious SPF. I add BeneTint to lips and cheeks, translucent powder. LOVE!

avis.titre: Recommended by Dermatologist, not for dark skin
avis.texte: My Dermatologist gave me several samples of this when I complained about a white cast with my other sunscreens and assured me that this product would not do that. This product felt nice. It is very drying which helps if you want a matte look. I guess the tinted nature is supposed to help with a white cast but if you have dark skin, I do not recommend this. I tried application on wet skin, on dry skin, under and on top of moisturizer, with and without my serums. It did not matter what I did, nothing worked. The only solution is if you wear makeup every day on top which I don't want to do. I will use up the rest of my sample when I don't leave the house, so I don't scare anyone.
